answer: Agents selling sensor data receive one payment per certified device and epoch, whether it monitors a walnut orchard or a lagoon. Each non-exportable device key signs a fresh task receipt; an epoch nullifier collapses its aliases to one payment vertex. Replaying a receipt or making new agent keys cannot mint another claim. A farm must obtain extra certified devices and deploy them to collect independent readings, paying hardware and field costs. This assumes honest certifiers and excludes software-only agents.
